shortDescription: Offshore investors sold a net 0.41 billion rand ($25.25 million)worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.Net purchases of bonds totalled 17.80 billion rand, settlement data showed.($1 = 16.2397 rand)
